title: Matte Black Foxtrot Towel Ring - 6-Inch Diameter, Wall Mount Solid Brass Bathroom Towel Holder, Allied Brass
body_html:
Tired of flimsy towel holders and mismatched finishes? This Foxtrot towel ring keeps hand towels within easy reach and is backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty — available in Matte Black, which makes a bold, modern statement with its sleek, non-reflective surface that anchors contemporary bathroom designs.

  • Matte Black makes a bold, modern statement
  • Coordinates with other Foxtrot pieces in Matte Black for a striking, cohesive modern look
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives
  • Designed to coordinate with the Foxtrot collection for a unified, designer bath accessories look

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Foxtrot collection, including coordinating textured bathroom hardware for a statement bath accessories finish.

Specs

  • Product type: Bathroom towel ring / towel holder
  • Dimensions (LxHxW): 6 x 6 x 6 in
  • Ring diameter: 6 in
  • Projection: 2 in
  • Material: Brass (solid brass construction)
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Included: Towel ring and all installation hardware
  • Assembly required: False
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
meta_description: Foxtrot towel ring with 6-inch diameter and wall-mount design. Solid brass bathroom towel holder with concealed mounting and Limited Lifetime Warranty.
